scripts.format: prettier --write . && uv run ruff format . && uv run ruff check --fix .
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace apps/desktop run typecheck && tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json && uv run mypy
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run contracts:check && npm test && npm run build
scripts.contracts:generate: uv run python -m scripts.generate_runtime_contracts && uv run python -m scripts.generate_cloud_contracts && npm --workspace packages/api-client run generate && prettier --write packages/api-client/runtime.openapi.json packages/api-client/runtime.generated.ts packages/api-client/cloud.openapi.json packages/api-client/cloud.generated.ts
scripts.security:scan: npm audit --audit-level=low && uv run pip-audit && node scripts/native.mjs audit
